item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 22/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A replenishment of the northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China gradually tomorrow. Temperatures will fall over the region. It will be rather cool on Monday morning. Under the influence of upper-air disturbances, there will be a few rain patches over Guangdong midweek next week. A humid maritime airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of next week. It will be warm during the day and misty over the region.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two rain patches at first. Bright periods in the afternoon. Cool in the morning and at night.
